curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What happens when Drey discovers the secret life Dan has kept from most of his students?
curatedMovie.description: Idealistic junior-high teacher Dan Dunne is committed to his students, but he harbors a hidden life of addiction. Everything shifts when Drey, a troubled student, uncovers his secret.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Deliberate and emotionally heavy, this thoughtful drama rewards quiet, solitary viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Ryan Fleck's drama sidesteps easy redemption, focusing on an uneasy dynamic where two vulnerable lives unexpectedly collide.
